facts.fact: At the SYNPIS congress of 8 October 2025 the union's outgoing secretary general said an INS committee had drafted an ordonnance setting the fundamental principles of statistical activity and instituting a national statistical system, and sent it to the Secretariat General of the Government for adoption.
facts.system: Projet d'ordonnance sur les principes fondamentaux des activités statistiques et instituant un Système Statistique National
